ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Webwork
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WEBWORK_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md, row 17). A jungle biome that drank its own river: everything grows dense and fast enough to watch, the water is inside the plants rather than on the map, and something large and patient waits in the canopy. RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it, and it is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet with nothing else loaded.
Ships in v1: - RM_Webwork BiomeDef: native label/description carried over verbatim (already franchise-free), workerClass RM_BiomeWorker_Webwork (tile-range scoring, same shape as the sibling Greentide/Pyrelands biome workers), vanilla-only terrain/weather/disease tables, and a Core-only wildAnimals/wildPlants roster (Rat/Hare/Muffalo/Megaspider/Cobra and Oak/Poplar/Bush/Grass/TallGrass/Berry) so the mod is functional on Core + DLCs alone. - RM_WebworkSettings : ModSettings with a worldgen-affecting master toggle (default ON) for whether RM_Webwork competes to generate on a freshly generated planet at all — off degrades gracefully to "this biome simply never wins a tile," nothing else changes. Future per- mechanic dials (front-creep margin, once WEBWORK_WEB_STRUCTURES_1 wires it) land here too. - RM_Ollathrix (OLLATHRIX_OWNER_SPECIES_1): the biome's own owner species, one race/one kind, invented and franchise-free (Q11a); the Utinni layer overlays a Wyyyschokk skin on the same defName via mandrake.rsw.shokk. SHOKK_SKIN_SHRINK_1 (S6 ruling 1) moved that species' own mechanisms — the mouth-loom ranged spit (RM_Gun_LoomSpit/RM_Bullet_LoomSpit/ RM_Damage_LoomSpit), the loom-bound hediff (RM_LoomBound) and sun-scald (RM_Webwork_SunScald, hediffClass in mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors — now a hard modDependency) inline onto this def, plus a general-purpose emergent-spawn ThingComp (RM_CompEmergentSpawnOnDestroy, gated by a new RM_WebworkSettings dial) for future harvest Things to attach — down from mandrake.rsw.shokk, which shrank to the skin patch alone. - The real Webwork-flavored flora and fauna roster (WEBWORK_FLORA_ROSTER_1, WEBWORK_FAUNA_ROSTER_1): 16 invented plants (Defs/ThingDefs_Plants/RM_WebworkFlora.xml) and 5 invented animals — quarrok, vennick, skennet, cravvet, sivvern (Defs/ThingDefs_Races/RM_WebworkFauna.xml) — replacing the interim vanilla-Core placeholder roster entirely. - The nest + egg economy (WEBWORK_NEST_EGG_ECONOMY_1, S6 rulings 2/3/4): RM_GenStep_WebworkNest guarantees one nest cluster (RM_Webwork_NestWall, the mother's dormant guardian spawner, plus 2-3 RM_Webwork_EggClutch mineable resource nodes) on every RM_Webwork map — no density roll, no empty-map outcome. RM_CompEggClutchRelay re-seeds a mined-out clutch every 20-30 days while any RM_Ollathrix is alive on the map. RM_OllathrixEgg is the harvested item: inert cargo (no CompHatcher, ban 1), Sellable in the free tier, RM_Contraband-tagged and tradeability-explicit so the campaign's later black-market patch has a node to match. The Wildsteam Clan's own legal bounty for destroying delivered eggs (S6 ruling 2) ships as a separate small mod, mandrake.rut.wildsteameggbounty (campaign-tier: it hard-depends on RUT_Jawa_WildsteamClan, so it cannot live in this franchise-free mod).
NOT in this mod (scoped to later items, not deferred sub rosa): the black-market Cartel trader/quest layer and tradeability-All patch (WEBWORK_EGG_BLACKMARKET_BUILD_1, S5 rulings), the nest's flavour-only hide-mass/flower-ring/mite-trail (owed to WEBWORK_WEB_STRUCTURES_1), the web-sense convergence AI and ThinkTree (WEBWORK_MECHANICS_1), the web structures kit (WEBWORK_WEB_STRUCTURES_1) and the soundscape (WEBWORK_SOUNDSCAPE_1). The Star Wars fauna cast that lives on the frozen campaign twin today rides its own Utinni patch (WildAnimals_Webwork.xml), never this def.
Live proof is OWED at publish time — see the item's own verify record.
